items.sql: SELECT telegram_posts FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'telegram' AND week = (SELECT max(week) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'telegram') LIMIT 1000
SELECT vacancies_active FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'habr' AND week = (SELECT max(week) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'habr') LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'hybrid' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) * 1.0) / SUM(vacancies) AS share, SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'hybrid' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) AS hybrid_vacancies, SUM(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'backend' LIMIT 1000
SELECT (with_salary_rub / vacancies) AS share, with_salary_rub, vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
SELECT salary_from_median FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'backend' AND grade = 'senior' AND region_group = 'remote' LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(mart_salaries.with_salary_rub) AS rub_salary_count FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE mart_salaries.source = 'trudvsem' AND mart_salaries.role_bucket = 'backend' AND mart_salaries.vacancies > 0 LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT skill) AS unique_skills_count FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_mentioning) AS total_junior_vacancies_with_sql FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills JOIN agent_snapshot.mart_junior ON mart_skills.source = mart_junior.source AND mart_skills.role_bucket = mart_junior.role_bucket AND mart_skills.grade = 'junior' WHERE mart_skills.skill = 'SQL' AND mart_skills.source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
SELECT telegram_channels FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE week = '2026-09-21' AND source = 'telegram' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'trudvsem_snapshot' LIMIT 1000
SELECT role_bucket, (open_to_junior * 1.0 / vacancies) AS share FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(no_experience_required) + SUM(graded_intern) + SUM(graded_junior) AS total_with_experience_filled FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT it_vacancies_seen FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Сбербанк%' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(mart_employers.open_it_vacancies) * 1.0) / SUM(mart_employers.it_vacancies_seen) AS share, SUM(mart_employers.open_it_vacancies) AS open_vacancies, SUM(mart_employers.it_vacancies_seen) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Сбербанк%' LIMIT 1000
SELECT lifetime_median_days FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Гринатом%' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT employer_key) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'habr' AND NOT (lifetime_median_days IS NULL) LIMIT 1000
SELECT role_bucket, vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'telegram' AND NOT (role_bucket IN ('multi_post')) ORDER BY vacancies DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT role_bucket, open_to_junior FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
